observations.01_gate_eye: Gate towers fit after retreating to local v=-160; central hall is framed by the actual gate opening. Mountain ridge appears behind the right campus buildings.
observations.02_court_eye: Central hall and volcanic hillside dominate the frame. Court paving and low boundary masses occupy the near foreground at 1.7m eye height.
observations.03_court_6m: Raised view exposes the avenue while retaining a clear central hall and large volcanic slope background.
observations.04_living_east_eye: Actual near living-wing wall occludes the left quarter; central hall and ridge remain visible. Useful for local approach, weaker as a complete campus overview.
observations.05_south_25m: Strongest frontal overview: gate, central hall, living wing, service wing and white tower occupy foreground; large mountain slope and ridge form the background.
observations.06_southeast_45m: Oblique overview fits the complete campus including the ironworks in foreground. 24mm gives more context and slightly smaller buildings than the preferred frontal view.
